svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: V4 data pipeline
svg.desc: Zoom of the V4 build. Fetch pulls filings, XBRL company facts, prices, macro and equity risk premium into a raw cache stamped with retrieved_at. Four lanes then run offline. Text: blocks, form-aware Item labels, validation, parent-child chunks, embeddings. Structured facts: company facts and inline XBRL merge into a facts table, which derives quarters and runs checks. Extraction: release chunks and the KPI registry go to one LLM call, code validates quotes and values, rows land in kpis and guidance. Market: prices, macro and ERP are dated by when each became public, with cross-checks planned. All lanes write one SQLite file.
svg.text: Fetch: tenk fetch, cache first, then offline-safe
raw/filings · raw/edgar · raw/prices · raw/macro, every file stamped retrieved_at in raw/manifest.json
Build: offline, one lane per kind of data
chunks · children · FTS5 · vectors · facts · quarters · kpis · guidance · market · exceptions
